sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Spl. Case No.41 of 2023, pending in the file of learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Spl. Court (under POCSO act), Jajpur, Dist-Jajpur, arising out of Sukinda P.S. Case No.64 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 363/366/294/506/376(2)(n)/34 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Spl. Court (under POCSO act), Jajpur, Dist-Jajpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge- cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Jajpur by order dated 08.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge- cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Jajpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 15.04.2023 and as charge sheet has been filed on 30.06.2023, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is not warranted.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

6. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.
7.

Considering the tenor thereof and taking into account the filing of charge sheet and period of custody, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the Krishna Jamuda vs State Of Odisha ....
